title: Extension Loadout
description: Extensions to turn on or off in this folder. Extensions not listed follow the global setting.

enable.description: Extensions to turn on here, even if they are off globally. Use an ID (publisher.name), a pattern with * or ? ("ms-toolsai.*"), or !ID to exclude something a pattern in this list matched.

disable.description: Extensions to turn off here. Use an ID (publisher.name), a pattern with * or ? ("ms-toolsai.*"), or !ID to exclude something a pattern in this list matched.

notes.description: Why an extension or pattern is on or off here. Shown in the Extension Loadout panel.

entry.patternErrorMessage: Use publisher.name, a pattern such as ms-toolsai.*, or !publisher.name.
